name: Boyfriend Exorcist
source:
Six feet never felt so far.

Fresh out of retail hell, you've found a new gig as an exorcist and travel to an isolated mansion for what should be a straightforward job. Things get weird fast when the ghost seems a little too happy to see you, and your new boss goes missing. Team up with a skeptic investigator and a terrified ghost hunter to investigate the haunting and get your paycheck... but what's with those markings in the basement?

Grab your spirit box - things are gonna get spooky.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2512480/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
六英尺从来没有这么远的感觉。

刚从零售业的地狱里出来，你找到了一份驱魔师的新工作，并前往一座偏僻的宅邸，从事本来应该很简单的工作。当鬼魂似乎太高兴见到你时，事情很快就会变得奇怪，而你的新老板却失踪了。与一名持怀疑态度的调查员和一名惊恐的幽灵猎人合作，调查闹鬼事件并获得薪水……但是地下室的那些标记是怎么回事？

拿起你的灵魂盒——事情会变得很诡异。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2512480/]Steam[/url]]
